SELECT
        o.id AS order_id,
        o.user_id AS user_id,
        hp.id as line_item_id,
        hp.prod_id as sku_id,
        CONCAT(o.first_name, ' ', o.last_name) AS customer_name,
        SUM(hp.qty) AS qty,
        ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(hp.pre_gst_amt, 0) * (1 + COALESCE(hp.gst, 0) / 100)), 2) AS amount,
        os.display_name AS order_status,
        hp.status AS line_item_status,
        eli.status AS express_line_item_status,
        o.created_at AS order_date,
        s.location_code AS location_code,
        s.store_name AS store_name,
        eosl.allocation_date,
        eosl.pack_date,
        eosl.pickup_date,
        eosl.delivery_date
    FROM express_line_item eli
    JOIN orders o        ON o.id  = eli.order_id
    JOIN has_products hp ON hp.id = eli.has_product_id
    JOIN stores s        ON s.id  = eli.store_id
    LEFT JOIN order_status os ON os.id = o.order_status
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
            order_id,
            store_id,
            MIN(CASE WHEN new_status = 'ACCEPTED'         THEN changed_at END) AS allocation_date,
            MIN(CASE WHEN new_status = 'PACKED'           THEN changed_at END) AS pack_date,
            MIN(CASE WHEN new_status = 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY' THEN changed_at END) AS pickup_date,
            MIN(CASE WHEN new_status = 'DELIVERED'        THEN changed_at END) AS delivery_date
        FROM express_order_status_log
        GROUP BY order_id, store_id
    ) eosl ON eosl.order_id = eli.order_id AND eosl.store_id = eli.store_id
    WHERE 1=1
 AND eli.store_id IN (1) AND eli.pending_expires_at BETWEEN '2026-11-16 00:00:00' AND '2026-11-16 23:59:59' GROUP BY o.id,o.user_id,hp.id,o.first_name,o.last_name,o.created_at,o.order_status,hp.status,eli.status,s.id,s.location_code,s.store_name ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
